referenceMethod: Visual inspection of the bomb emblem and approved penguin proof, followed by explicit text description of their pixel style in each prompt.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated illustration for a BAIT game card. Style matches the approved BAIT bomb emblem and card art: chunky square pixel clusters, stepped contours, heavy dark aubergine outline, bright cream highlights, warm orange and amber accent bands, purple midtones, small pale cyan highlights. Limited arcade-sprite palette. Flat pixel-art shading, no smooth gradients, no blur, no tiny speckled details. Centered square composition, whole subject visible, generous transparent margin about 16 percent. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no scenery, no ground, no cast-shadow plane, no frame, no card border, no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Illustration only; typography will be drawn in the app. No bomb or hook. Subject: a compact brass TELESCOPE on a sturdy three-legged purple tripod, aimed diagonally upwards. Big amber-gold barrel with a pale cyan glass objective lens and cream block highlights, small dark eyepiece, a couple of broad metal bands. Three-quarter view, clear silhouette, chunky playful proportions. No stars, sky, moons, characters or extra props.
